name: Agent-Skills
tagline_zh: 不用再逐个项目手写 prompt 或翻旧笔记。同一个技能仓库，三端通用。
tagline_en: Stop rewriting prompts per project. Install once, share the same skills across three agent runtimes, and keep.
desc_en: Shared Agent Skills for Codex, Claude Code, and autonomous project agents
why_zh: 它把技能定义成跨平台共享的格式，而不是绑死在某一个 CLI 的私有配置里。一次维护，处处生效。
why_en: It decouples skill definitions from any single CLI, so you maintain once and run everywhere. Built for the multi-agent era, not.
limit_zh: 只提供技能定义与共享机制，不附带技能内容本身。仓库内若没有你需要的具体技能，装完仍是空架子。
limit_en: Ships the shared format and loader only, not the skills themselves. Empty until you add your own; requires you to already know each CLI's install.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: One skill repo for Codex, Claude Code, and autonomous agents
